legislation.name: Loi organique / Loi / Ordonnance
legislation.via: Journal Officiel de la République Algérienne (JORADP), Secrétariat Général du Gouvernement
legislation.note: full text from 2002 on (475 Loi/Loi organique/Ordonnance in the JO index), as published, not consolidated. Missing: the 1,794 primary acts published before 2002 (Loi 399, Loi organique 3, Ordonnance 1,354, Décret législatif 38; JO index counts 2026-11-10) are scans with no text layer (no OCR), incl. base texts of codes in force (Code civil Ord. 75-58, Code pénal Ord. 66-156, Code de la famille Loi 84-11) No text source for them: French and Arabic JO issues before 2002 are scans (checked 2026-11-10); droit.mjustice.dz connect timeout.

elsewhere.source: JORADP scans / Arabic edition; no third-party text source
elsewhere.evidence: fetched 2026-11-10: A2003001, A2008021, A2024001 HTTP 200, text extracted with pypdf; F1994001 and F1998001 HTTP 200, 0 characters of text
elsewhere.note: Missing part: text of the 1,794 primary acts published before 2002. French JO issues before 2002 are scans without a text layer (rechecked 1994 and 1998 issue 1, 2026-11-10; earlier: 1996, 2000, 2001); text would need OCR, which Fontes does not do. Arabic (authoritative) issues /FTP/jo-arabe/{year}/A{year}{jo:03}.pdf: no text layer in 1975, 1990, 2000, 2001; where there is one the font maps are broken in a different way per era (rechecked 2026-11-10: A2003001 is glyph garbage in a custom encoding; A2008021 has letters in logical order but words in reversed visual order and lam-mim/ba-mim ligatures mapped to 'J', '~', 's'; A2024001 has every line character-reversed with digit runs scrambled), so it is not served; it would not fill the pre-2002 gap anyway. No other text source reached (2026-11-10): www.mjustice.dz, droit.mjustice.dz, apn.dz and coursupreme.dz connect timeout; droit-afrique.com answers 403 even on robots.txt; majliselouma.dz has no law database; joradp.dz has no consolidated codes.
